name: remote-start
description: The session Spark starts. The charger boots, reports Available, then Preparing because the driver has plugged the cable in (Spark refuses to prepare a session on an unplugged connector), and waits for a RemoteStartTransaction from the app or panel; the VCP answers Accepted and starts the transaction itself, exactly as a real one does. It then charges until Spark sends RemoteStopTransaction. Run it, then start and later stop the session in Spark.
